_metadata.title: Situation Primitives — Cross-Framework Mapping Table
_metadata.project: Mask (面具) — Psychiatric Hospital Supernatural Observer-Effect Game
_metadata.purpose: Bridge RDoC domains, appraisal dimensions, Kroell14 networks, and game levels (L0-L5) into composable situation archetypes for NPC AI and combat design.
sources: Scherer (2001, 2009); Lazarus (1991); Smith & Ellsworth (1985): 7 appraisal dimensions
Kroell et al. (2024): 14 meta-analytically derived functional networks
Hansen et al. (2024) Nat Neurosci: brainstem-cortical FC hierarchy
FreeSurfer DK/aseg atlas (50 anatomical entities) + Hansen 2024 brainstem nuclei (10)
_metadata.how_to_use: Each situation archetype defines a game-relevant scenario. NPC AI uses the rdoc_profile + appraisal_profile to select which skills to activate. The primary_networks and levels_involved determine which brain-region skill tree nodes are relevant. auto_activated_links define reflex neural links that fire immediately upon entering the situation.

negative_valence.description: Responses to aversive stimuli or contexts (threat, loss, frustration).

acute_threat.definition: Active defensive response to imminent danger. Fast, short-lived, high arousal.
acute_threat.game_notes: 恐慌强制——月光下威胁感知放大，PAG防御阈值降低

potential_threat.definition: Hypervigilance in ambiguous contexts. Sustained readiness for possible danger.
potential_threat.game_notes: 持续警觉状态——探索扭曲医院走廊时的默认背景状态

sustained_threat.definition: Prolonged exposure to danger. Leads to chronic stress, HPA-axis dysregulation.
sustained_threat.game_notes: 长期暴露在污染月光区后的SAN持续下降状态

loss.definition: Response to the absence of a valued person, object, or opportunity. Grief, sadness.
loss.game_notes: NPC同伴死亡或重要道具损毁后的情绪状态

frustrative_nonreward.definition: Response when expected reward is omitted. Anger, aggression, extinction burst.
frustrative_nonreward.game_notes: 解谜失败、被NPC拒绝、预期奖励落空后的愤怒加成

positive_valence.description: Responses to rewarding stimuli and contexts. Approach motivation.

reward_responsiveness.definition: Initial hedonic response to reward receipt. Liking.
reward_responsiveness.game_notes: 发现关键道具、解开谜题、成功说服NPC时的即时满足

reward_learning.definition: Process of associating cues/stimuli/actions with future reward. Wanting.
reward_learning.game_notes: 学习哪些NPC值得信任、哪些区域安全——形成情境-奖赏关联

reward_valuation.definition: Comparing and choosing among reward options. Cost-benefit computation.
reward_valuation.game_notes: 二选一抉择——救哪个NPC、信任哪个线索、走哪条路

cognitive_systems.description: Systems supporting attention, memory, language, and cognitive control.

attention.definition: Selective allocation of processing resources to relevant stimuli.
attention.game_notes: 扫描环境、发现隐藏线索、在战斗中锁定目标

perception.definition: Sensory processing and pattern recognition of internal/external stimuli.
perception.game_notes: 识别扭曲后的医院环境——意识外显效应导致感知失真

declarative_memory.definition: Encoding, consolidation, and retrieval of facts and events.
declarative_memory.game_notes: 记忆闪回——月光触发被压抑的患者记忆

language.definition: Production and comprehension of spoken/written/signed communication.
language.game_notes: 命名是核心机制——在月光下给事物命名改变现实

cognitive_control.definition: Regulation of thought and behavior through inhibition, switching, and updating.
cognitive_control.game_notes: 压制恐慌、维持策略、在混乱中保持专注——消耗 SAN

working_memory.definition: Online maintenance and manipulation of information for cognition.
working_memory.game_notes: 跟踪多步计划——月光下工作记忆容量下降

social_processes.description: Processing of social stimuli and regulation of interpersonal behavior.

affiliation_attachment.definition: Formation and maintenance of social bonds. Tend-and-befriend.
affiliation_attachment.game_notes: 与NPC建立信任关系——影响其在月光下的行为

social_communication.definition: Interpretation and production of communicative signals (facial, vocal, gestural).
social_communication.game_notes: 识别NPC的欺骗信号、读懂敌意——或者伪装自己的意图

perception_of_self.definition: Awareness of one's own traits, history, and agency.
perception_of_self.game_notes: 面具系统——玩家角色在月光下反思自己是谁，技能树L5叙事框架的入口

perception_of_others.definition: Inferring others' traits, intentions, and mental states. Theory of Mind.
perception_of_others.game_notes: 读心——在月光下他人的真实想法可能具象化

arousal_regulatory.description: Systems regulating arousal, circadian rhythms, and sleep-wake states.

arousal.definition: General level of alertness and readiness to process stimuli.
arousal.game_notes: 蓝斑NE广播——月光提高全局唤醒，但过度唤醒导致恐慌易发

circadian_rhythms.definition: Endogenous 24-hour cycles regulating physiology and behavior.
circadian_rhythms.game_notes: 月相系统——满月时意识外显效应最强，NPC行为最不可预测

sleep_wakefulness.definition: Regulation of vigilance states and sleep homeostasis.
sleep_wakefulness.game_notes: 医院中睡眠被剥夺 → SAN恢复受损 → SAN 恢复受损加剧

sensorimotor.description: Control and monitoring of motor output, agency, and habit formation.

motor_actions.game_notes: 闪避、逃跑、攻击动作的执行——基础物理战斗

agency_ownership.definition: Sense that one controls one's own actions and body.
agency_ownership.game_notes: 意识外显效应核心——月光模糊自我-他者边界，行动归属感被扭曲

habits.definition: Automatized stimulus-response associations. Chunked action sequences.
habits.game_notes: 熟练技能不消耗 SAN——训练后的反射性动作

innate_motor_patterns.definition: Species-typical fixed action patterns. Startle, flinch, orienting.
innate_motor_patterns.game_notes: 惊吓反射、闪避、冻结——不可压制的L0原子操作

novelty.description: Is this new or familiar? Unexpected? Sudden onset? Neural: hippocampus, SC, SN.
novelty.game_mechanics: 熟悉场景安全(低新颖性→低防御激活)；从未见过的扭曲怪物(高新颖性→强制警觉)

intrinsic_pleasantness.description: Is this good or bad in itself? Neural: NAcc, amygdala, OFC, insula.
intrinsic_pleasantness.game_mechanics: 天生厌恶(血腥、腐烂)→自动负效价；习得性偏好(白色制服→NPC友好度)→条件性效价

goal_relevance.description: Does this matter to my current goals? Neural: ACC, OFC, insula, dlPFC.
goal_relevance.game_mechanics: 高相关性→占据注意力；低相关性→被SN过滤忽略

coping_potential.description: Can I handle/control this? Power, control, resources. Neural: dlPFC, vmPFC, ACC.
coping_potential.game_mechanics: 低应对潜力→PAG防御激活(逃跑/冻结)；高应对潜力→dlPFC策略规划

agency_causation.description: Who caused this? Self / Other / Circumstance. Neural: TPJ, insula, precuneus, mPFC.
agency_causation.game_mechanics: 归因他人→社会认知网络激活(ToM)；归因环境→突显网络；归因自我→自我参照网络。月光下归因错误频发

certainty_predictability.description: Do I know what will happen next? Certain vs. uncertain outcome. Neural: dlPFC, ACC, striatum.
certainty_predictability.game_mechanics: 高不确定性→焦虑(BNST持续激活)；完全不可预测→恐慌强制检查。确定性→OFC价值计算

norm_standard_compatibility.description: Does this match my internal and external standards? Neural: mPFC, TPJ, OFC, insula.
norm_standard_compatibility.game_mechanics: 违反规范→前脑岛+ACC冲突信号→认知负荷增加。道德抉择的核心维度

functional_networks._note: Full Kroell14 network definitions with constituent brain regions from the game atlas. See kroell14_networks.md for complete literature references.

networks.name: Autobiographical Memory
networks.game_level_span: L1→L5 (L1 hippocampus encoding → L5 mPFC/TPJ retrieval)

networks.name: Cognitive Attention Control
networks.game_level_span: L0→L5 (L0 SC/LC arousal → L5 dlPFC control)

networks.name: Extended Multiple Demand Network
networks.game_level_span: L1→L5 (basal ganglia loops to prefrontal control)

networks.name: Emotional Scene & Face Processing
networks.game_level_span: L1→L4 (L1 amygdala → L4 fusiform face recognition)

networks.name: Emotion Regulation
networks.game_level_span: L1→L5 (L1 amygdala activation → L5 dlPFC reappraisal)

networks.name: Mirror Neuron System
networks.game_level_span: L3→L5 (L3 S1/M1 → L5 Broca action understanding)

networks.name: Theory of Mind
networks.game_level_span: L4→L5 (L4 STS biological motion → L5 TPJ intention inference)

networks.name: Working Memory
networks.game_level_span: L1→L5 (L1 thalamus relay → L5 dlPFC manipulation)

game_levels._description: Maps the 6-level functional hierarchy (L0-L5) to brain regions, Kroell networks, and RDoC domains. ⚠️ L6 level was removed (2026-08-07 Grilling #25) — L5 absorbs top-level functions.

L0.description: Survival atoms. Fastest (~10-30ms), most mandatory, cannot be fully suppressed.
L0.game_role: 原子操作——被动技能，自动触发。L0技能不消耗 SAN

L1.description: Core emotion and memory. ~20-80ms. Experience-dependent modulation of L0.
L1.game_role: 情绪学习+记忆形成。调制L0防御阈值。自动触发或占 Broca 通道

L2.description: Interoception and salience detection. ~50-120ms. Decides 'what matters'.
L2.game_role: 该不该在意——突显标记。直觉决策但尚未语言化。混合主动/被动

L3.description: Raw external input. ~30-80ms. Passive reception of light, sound, touch, motion.
L3.game_role: 信息获取——扫描/观察类主动技能。被L0唤醒度调制

L4.description: Pattern recognition and classification. ~80-150ms. Labels the world.
L4.game_role: 贴标签——识别分类。自动识别(被动)与仔细辨认(主动)混合。中等AP消耗

L5.description: Language, reasoning, social cognition, multi-modal integration. ~150-300ms.
L5.game_role: 最灵活但最贵——高AP消耗，长冷却。命名是核心机制(意识外显效应)。占 Broca 通道

L6._deprecated: ⚠️ L6 层级已删除（2026-08-07 Grilling #25）。旧 L6 功能（DMN/FPN/SN 自我叙事、跨网络协调）已并入 L5 + L2 网络涌现属性。此条目保留为数据兼容占位。
L6.display_name: 跨模态整合 (Whole-Brain Integration) — ⚠️ 已废弃
L6.description: ⚠️ 已废弃。功能已迁移至 L5。
L6.game_role: ⚠️ 已废弃——终极技能层约束（长冷却8-12回合、一场战斗1-2次、月光最强）已并入 L5 最顶级链路。

composition_rules._description: How situation archetypes combine in practice. Archetypes are rarely alone — they layer, chain, and merge.

combinations.name: threat_during_confrontation
combinations.result: Social confrontation escalates to violence. The NPC's emotional state spells over into physical attack. RDoC: social + negative_valence both high. Brain: amygdala drives both social evaluation AND fear response — TPJ-mPFC loop competes with PAG reflex.
combinations.game_example: 被揭穿面具的NPC不是逃跑而是直接攻击→社交冲突升级为战斗。叠加了社交背叛的SAN伤害+物理HP伤害。

combinations.name: traumatic_discovery
combinations.result: Searching for clues leads to finding something horrific. Investigation reward is negated by trauma cost. RDoC: cognitive drops as negative_valence spikes. Brain: ACC-hippocampus conflict — 'I found what I was looking for but I wish I hadn't.'
combinations.game_example: 搜索医生办公室→发现日记记载了患者被虐待的真实记录→目睹记忆闪回中的创伤场景。找到了关键线索但付出了SAN代价。

combinations.name: desperate_escape
combinations.result: Being chased while managing limited cognitive resources against a deadline. Maximum L0 panic pressure combined with L5 strategy failure risk. RDoC: sensorimotor + cognitive competing for priority. Brain: PAG (flee) vs dlPFC (plan) — cognitive load determines which wins.
combinations.game_example: 被实体追逐时必须同时导航迷宫出口+管理注意力。如果注意力过载→无法压制恐慌→强制冻结=死亡。月光下逃跑路径也在变化。

combinations.name: betrayal_in_combat
combinations.result: An ally turns hostile mid-fight. Sudden re-evaluation of all combat assumptions. RDoC: social_processes spike during combat, splitting attention. Brain: TPJ-mPFC belief updating competes with M1 motor execution.
combinations.game_example: 正在对抗怪物时，信任的NPC从背后攻击玩家。需要同时维持战斗节奏+重新评估盟友状态→注意力双倍占用。

combinations.name: healing_under_threat
combinations.result: Attempting restorative activity while danger is present. Ritual interrupted = partial effect + cognitive load waste. RDoC: positive_valence (healing) vs negative_valence (threat) compete. Brain: vmPFC-DMN (calm) vs PAG-amygdala (alarm) — SN chooses which network dominates.
combinations.game_example: 躲在看似安全的房间恢复SAN→突然怪物破窗而入。治疗被中断只恢复50%效果+损失AP。突显网络必须在内部恢复和外部威胁间切换。

combinations.name: grief_during_flashback
combinations.result: Memory of loss triggered by environmental cue. Past and present trauma compound. RDoC: autobiographical memory + negative_valence reinforcing loop. Brain: hippocampus-DMN replay + amygdala reconsolidation — each flashback strengthens the traumatic association.
combinations.game_example: 走过走廊闻到特定消毒水味→触发在该房间失去盟友的记忆→闪回中重新经历那一幕。反复闪回→创伤记忆强化→后续触发阈值降低。

combinations.name: negotiation_under_deception
combinations.result: A negotiation where one party is lying. Requires real-time deception detection while maintaining bargaining position. RDoC: social + cognitive both high. Brain: TPJ-ToM for lie detection, OFC-vmPFC for value calculation, ACC for contradiction monitoring.
combinations.game_example: 与看起来友善的NPC交易物资→同时正在说谎(他要害你)。玩家必须同时谈判+察觉欺骗+决定是否揭穿。揭穿→可能战斗；不揭穿→可能被坑。

combinations.name: moral_crisis_isolation
combinations.result: A moral choice with no social support or external validation. Pure internal conflict. RDoC: social (internalized norms) vs negative_valence (fear of wrong choice). Brain: vmPFC-mPFC moral reasoning without TPJ social feedback — self vs superego.
combinations.game_example: 独自一人发现一个可以逃出医院的机会——但代价是释放所有患者。没有NPC提供建议，没有社会镜子。纯粹的内心道德冲突在月光下放大。

combinations.name: territorial_escape
combinations.result: Entering a claimed territory triggers immediate chase. No warning phase. RDoC: negative_valence max, cognitive min — pure reflexive response. Brain: SC→PAG→escape reflex bypasses cortex entirely. No time for appraisal.
combinations.game_example: 误入某个实体的核心领地→对方立即感知并发起追击。没有任何谈判或观察窗口——L0反射直接接管。玩家必须纯靠本能反应求生。

combinations.name: identity_investigation
combinations.result: Investigating the mystery of the hospital leads to discoveries that challenge the player's own identity. The investigation subject IS the player. RDoC: social (self) + cognitive (search). Brain: DMN (self-narrative) + FPN (investigation) compete for SN routing.
combinations.game_example: 搜索医院记录时发现一份患者档案——档案描述的经历与玩家自己的记忆完全吻合。我是调查者还是被调查者?L5 DMN自我叙事必须整合这一矛盾。

merge_rules.description: When archetypes combine, the RDoC profile is a weighted average weighted by intensity (0-1). The domain with highest score drives NPC behavior selection priority.
Physical threat overrides all appraisal dimensions except 'coping' and 'certainty' — those remain independently computed. Social situations preserve full appraisal set.
Combined situations activate the union of both archetypes' primary networks, but cognitive load (total active networks) cannot exceed 3 without penalty (overload).
Combined situations span from the lowest L to the highest L of component archetypes. Wider span = more brain regions involved = higher cognitive load.
If either component activates an L0 reflex (PAG, SC, LC), the reflex auto-triggers before any L5 cognitive processing — unless the player spends cognitive load to suppress it.

Moonlight intensity multiplies all archetype intensities by 1.0-2.0x (depending on phase). In full moon: appraisal certainty→0 for all ambiguous situations, novelty→1.0, and auto_activated_links have a chance to 'cross-wire' to wrong targets.
